title: Florence
completionText: You depart Florence with eyes full of Botticelli and pockets full of forged Medici medals. Venice awaits.

cards.dialogue: "You cross the Apennines and descend into the Arno valley. Florence sits like a jewel in the dust, and you have letters of introduction in your pocket."
cards.leftChoice: Rest a day at the inn
cards.rightChoice: Call at once on your contact
cards.leftText: You wash off the road dust and write letters. The Arno glints below your window.
cards.rightText: Signor Bardi receives you graciously. By evening you have invitations to three dinners.
